summary: Joint county and state lookout near Hermosa, built 1955 (firelookout.com says 1954); removed in 2002 and listed as gone; no current site description found.

facts.design: 35-foot steel tower with a 7-by-7-foot cab and a cabin at ground level for living quarters
facts.status_note: Removed in 2002 per the FFLOS register; no source describes what remains at the site.

access.note: No source found says whether the site is open to visitors.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and the July 1955 newspaper item support 1955; firelookout.com says 1954. Story uses 1955 and reports the disagreement.

Register says Custer County; firelookout.com and the statewide list say Pennington County, and the 1955 item was about a tower near Hermosa. Editor should confirm against the coordinates before publishing.

notes_for_editor: Built year (1955 vs 1954) and county (Custer vs Pennington) disagree across sources; story reports both. Two searches found no description of the site today and no access information, so access stays unknown. Newspaper items were read as quoted on westlookouts.weebly.com, not from the original papers. The 35-foot height comes from firelookout.com alone.
